svg.title: Track DNA amount separately from chromosome number
svg.desc: A phase-ordered plot for a2n=4 cell shows DNA molecules at4 through G1, increasing to8 during S phase and remaining8 in G2. A dashed chromosome-count line remains4 through all three phases. Ploidy remains diploid. Phase widths are not measured times and no straight-line replication-rate claim is intended. The plot does not depict chromosome condensation. After normal mitosis and cytokinesis, each daughter has4 chromosomes and4 DNA molecules.

g.text: Track DNA amount separately from chromosome number
Replication changes the copy count; it does not double the number of homologous sets.
DNA replication forms sisters without adding homologous sets: ploidy stays 2n.
The horizontal axis orders phases; its widths are not measured durations.
Chromatin organization is not represented by this quantity plot.
After normal mitosis and cytokinesis, each daughter again has 4 chromosomes and 4 DNA molecules.
